build_qwen2moe_model: build a Qwen2MoE causal language model with tensor parallel and expert parallel support
load_qwen2moe_weights: load HuggingFace checkpoint weights into a Qwen2MoE model with stacked and expert parameter mapping
run_qwen2moe_forward: run inference forward pass on a Qwen2MoE model with positions, input IDs, and forward batch info
configure_expert_routing: configure MoE expert routing with top-k selection, shared expert fusion, and router logits
set_eagle3_capture_layers: set EAGLE3 auxiliary hidden state capture layers on a Qwen2MoE model for speculative decoding
